title: A Summit for the Landfall
author: Tamsin Galloway
blurb: Edmund Montrose, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
